  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":647,"var":"render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text","code":"if (!render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text.str) return;","note":"A \clip override can leave an empty drawing string view that is still considered present."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":652,"var":"ol_key.u.drawing.text","code":"ol_key.u.drawing.text = render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text;","note":"The empty string view is copied into the outline cache key used for hashing."},
